_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.385 corrects how SysID establishes a sealed, settled pressure before measuring valve response.

- Wait with the valve closed before bleeding inflation headroom. After pumping, allow up to 45 seconds of extra settling within the existing 180-second preparation budget.
- In pressure-matched SysID, an exponential decay extrapolation is diagnostic. Require supported measured decay within 0.85 mmHg/s, then the original two independent local baseline windows. HIGH must retain pressure support at or above 80 mmHg. Fresh IDLE telemetry must confirm pump off and valve closed before probing.
- Prepare the full 30-second preflight near 90 mmHg, retaining the measured landing tolerance, 70-mmHg endpoint floor, 100-mmHg preparation command cap, and bounded corrections. Production PVR targets are unchanged.

Validation: 735 combined SysID, installer, and workflow tests passed. All seven legacy smoke suites, helpers, parsers, analyzers, and the final 179 worker assertions passed. New regressions cover open-valve, stale, unsupported, and changing sealed histories. These are software checks; no complete independently validated large-cuff SysID model has been accepted.

Four new measurement-only attempts and every original failed run remain retained with serial data, raw sensor voltages, all three native NI channels, exact source freezes, and complete device readbacks where acquisition occurred. The latest attempt lost pressure from 89.57 to 59.79 mmHg during the 30-second sealed preflight and correctly rejected before scanning. The preceding attempt passed preflight but measured HIGH sealed decay of 1.498 mmHg/s despite a predicted asymptote of 0.246. No new tuning or calibration snapshot was adopted. The physical cause of changing sealed loss remains unresolved.

Firmware remains rev27v-followup-351. Saved device tuning, calibration, clinical protocols, PVR peak+5, Smart Const/High Max caps 130/140 mmHg, and fallback 80 mmHg are unchanged. Source: default commit 4f6c4dbed6dc3c0f403db1c04c445f698273aaf1.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
